title: Towards Understanding Task-agnostic Debiasing Through the Lenses of Intrinsic Bias and Forgetfulness

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using intrinsic metrics (StereoSet scores) and extrinsic downstream task metrics (e.g., True Positive Rate differences in BiasBios, and prediction ratio differences in NLI-bias and STS-B for male-relevant vs. female-relevant samples). Additionally, the authors use Causal Mediation Analysis (CMA) to assess the probability gaps between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical predictions by swapping gender words in text prompts.
